correctness.rationale: For each forbidden value j, an adjacent exchange cannot change whether j is left or right of prohibited position j without temporarily placing j at position j. Endpoints have forced side. Given any choices for internal forbidden labels, the sorted blocks L increasing, unrestricted U increasing and R increasing form a feasible representative because j in L occupies <=j-1 and j in R occupies >=j+1. Sorting a feasible word by target block order swaps only adjacent inversions: L entries move left, R entries move right, U is unrestricted; within L and R the inequality from feasibility ensures exchanges remain legal. At most binom(n,2) such swaps to canonical representative; component diameter <=n(n-1). Independently generated every F subset and feasible permutation for n=2..7, 252 masks and 421830 feasible graph vertices, confirming exact 2^|F internal| component count.
residual_risks: Upper diameter is not asserted sharp and no exact component sizes are obtained.
